name: Billing
pass_mark: Realised tax / declared volume lies within 0.20 x the NPA range of groups 2-4 for that year. Below the range is a billing leak.
detail: Kota Semarang: realised groundwater tax / ESDM declared volume = Rp 2,188/m3 (2022) and Rp 2,245/m3 (2023), inside 0.20 x the Pergub 54/2018 HDA range for use groups 2-4 in Wilayah A (Rp 2,100-2,480/m3). 2024 not tested: declared volume not yet published. Other regions: realised tax not obtained.

name: Volume split
pass_mark: Error within 1.5x on unseen regions at 16 km.

name: Sinking maps
pass_mark: Signals repeat across periods and tracks above a random null.

name: Arizona leads
pass_mark: New large buildings with a new registered well within 500 m in t to t+2 are at least 1.5x the built-matched null; one-sided permutation p < 0.05.
detail: 1094 new built patches (1,000 m2 to 25 ha, IO land cover 2018-2021) outside ADWR water-provider areas: 184 got a new registered well within 500 m in t to t+2 (16.8%) vs 12.2% for built-matched existing sites (ratio 1.38, p = 0.0001). New buildings pull new wells more than chance, but less than the 1.5x pass mark.

name: Semarang permits
pass_mark: Leads fall on permitted wells more often than random new buildings of the same size, p < 0.05.
detail: 20 buildings passing filters 1-3: 5 within 250 m of a permitted well (25%) vs 14% for size-matched new buildings, p = 0.153. Above the null, but not significant with 20 buildings.

name: Field hit rate
pass_mark: No pass mark; reported per lead class with a 90 % interval.

name: SPAM test
pass_mark: Delta below the 5th percentile of the shift null, and both placebos between the 5th and 95th percentiles.
detail: Delta +5.9 mm/yr (shift null 5th-95th: +0.7 to +5.9, p = 0.95); placebo years +2.5 (clean), placebo area -6.2 (clean). Served kecamatan did not slow more than matched controls.

name: Positive control in Arizona
pass_mark: The same test detects a known, metered pumping cut.
detail: 5 Arizona blocks with a >= 50 % metered cut: Delta -0.68 mm/yr vs shift-null 5th percentile -1.48 (p = 0.48). The method does not see a known, metered cut.
